targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(AVG((status = 'done')::int), 0) * 100 AS value FROM user_node_progress
SELECT COALESCE(100.0 * SUM((event_name = 'rag_answer')::int) / NULLIF(SUM((event_name IN ('rag_answer','rag_escalation'))::int), 0), 0) AS value FROM clickstream_events
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM service_requests WHERE status = 'completed'
SELECT pulse_date AS time, AVG(mood_score) AS mood FROM daily_pulses GROUP BY pulse_date ORDER BY pulse_date
